The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Sorro's family''' was a family that [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] theorized<ref name="COC" /> was located on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]].<ref name="COC" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]<ref name="Esva">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Choices of One]]'', which include [[Sorro]] serving [[Nuso Esva]], to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. As Sorro was serving Esva during that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Gender/Legends|his]] family must have been [[Death/Legends|killed]] or held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by 0 ABY.</ref> the family was [[Death/Legends|killed]] or captured by [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], forcing Sorro to serve him as his [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] aboard the [[Kazellis-class light freighter|''Kazellis''-class light freighter]] ''[[Salaban's Hope]]''.<ref name="COC" /> In 0 ABY,<ref name="Esva" /> the pair traveled to the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], where the warlord lied to the the [[Warship/Legends|ship's]] [[Executive officer/Legends|first officer]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], telling him that the family was "lost" after the Human made bad choices. Pellaeon [[Death/Legends|killed]] Sorro while he wore his master's [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], and told the pilot that he had redeemed his family. After Esva's [[Battle of the Poln system|retreat]], Thrawn asked [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]] to free Sorro's family which he believed was being held hostage along with the town they lived in, and Car'das accepted to at least take a look.<ref name="COC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sorro's family appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="COC" />
